part: Mobile 390 — Map page (outer grid folds to one column, rail under the content, masthead contains its command bar)
artboards: 10-map (desktop); mobile-390 text spec (no 390 artboard PNG exists yet)
source: docs/design/handoff-2026-09-06/DEVIATION-LOG.md 'MOBILE 390 SPEC', sections BREAKPOINTS ('below 1280: rail folds under the content') and MASTHEAD; operator mobile report 2026-09-08, D-M3.
notes: THE SPEC THIS LANE ADDS (mobfix61, 2026-09-08). The map page was the one surface with no 390 spec at all, and it was the surface the operator's own screenshot showed worst: its rail cards were drawn ON TOP of the MODE / BAND / REGION chip rows.

[CONFIRMED root cause, twice over] MapPageView.tsx's outer div is the two-column grid (`minmax(0,1fr) 300px`, className `cl-map-outer`), and the file's only media query named `.cl-map-grid` — the INNER content column, which is a `display: flex` element on which `grid-template-columns` does nothing at all. So the rule was dead twice over and the 300px rail track survived at every width. Nothing in the toolchain could see it: a CSS selector matching no element is not an error in any language involved. That is why the fix ships with F40 (.discipline/fitness/functions/F40-dead-media-query-class.mjs) rather than with a spec row alone.
The boundsCheck below is the part that cannot be satisfied by accident: it asserts every direct child of the outer grid is contained by it, which is exactly the assertion the overlapping rail failed.

`compiledCss: true` for the same reason every other mobile-* spec sets it — AppShell/Sidebar/TopBar express the desktop/mobile switch as Tailwind `md:` utilities that a raw globals.css read leaves un-expanded.

children.note: One track, at the full content width inside the 16px page padding (390 - 32 = 358). Before the fix this read `minmax(0,1fr) 300px` at every width and the two tracks were laid out over each other.

children.name: The register row is the shared part's `register` variant, at its 390 measure
children.note: UPDATED AT FOLD-61, because the structure this row described no longer exists. mobile60/mobfix61 were cut from wave59 and wrote this against `.cl-list-row`; train 60's lane map60 rebuilt the register on ListRow's own `variant="register"` (dc.html p10's six-column grid) and DELETED the old approximation, so all four register rows here reported NOT BUILT against a row that renders correctly. The spec is repointed at the surviving structure, not weakened: it still asserts exact tracks. The 68px band/count column and the 40px arrow are the fold's measured mobile reflow of that grid (see ListRow.tsx's own comment) - the two flexible tracks computed to 18.5px each at 390 before it, which is one character and an ellipsis.

forbid.name: no literal UNSCORED token anywhere
forbid.reason: Operator ruling P1 2.1. Matched against RENDERED text (run-audit.mjs's renderedText) — the source writes it lower case and CSS uppercases it, which is how nineteen specs' worth of this forbid matched nothing for as long as they existed.

forbid.name: no floating Ask AI control
forbid.reason: Operator ruling P1 2.2: the masthead command bar is the only ask surface, at any width.

forbid.name: D-M4: no list row carries more than one absence token
forbid.reason: D-M4 (operator mobile report 2026-09-08) [CONFIRMED at 1440 and at 390]. The impact, due and tier cells each rendered their own <Absence>, so a row missing all three drew a dashed baseline plus UNSCORED plus PENDING plus NOT IN PRIMARY SOURCE — three tokens, the third on a line of its own. Ruling 2.1 allows exactly ONE reason per row. This selector matches a row carrying a token in TWO of the three cells, which is the defect and nothing else. The structural guarantee is ListRow's `reasonSlot`.

boundsCheck.name: D-M3: nothing in the map page escapes the outer grid at 390
boundsCheck.reason: The defect exactly: with the 300px rail track alive at 390 the rail column was laid out outside and over the content column. A direct child wider than its own grid is the recurrence.

boundsCheck.name: D-M5: the masthead card contains its command bar
boundsCheck.reason: Operator: "search bar touched bounding box". Measured at 390 before the fix on a sibling surface: card bottom 186.3, bar bottom 185.3 — the bar sat on the card's border.

boundsCheck.name: no register cell overlaps a sibling or escapes its row at 390
boundsCheck.reason: UPDATED AT FOLD-61: the container was `.cl-list-row`, the shared list row this register no longer is (lane map60 gave it its own `variant="register"` anatomy), so the check matched nothing and passed by absence. It now measures the row that actually renders, whose four mobile tracks are the fold's own fix for a name column that computed to 18.5px. The stretched row-link overlay is excluded by selector, exactly as the list-row bounds checks exclude it: it is `position:absolute; inset:0` by design (README 0.4, the whole row is the one click target), so it overlaps every cell on purpose and would make this check permanently red.
